name: Bicep what-if
short_description: A deployment preview that compares a Bicep file with the resources already in Azure and shows what would be created, modified or deleted, without making any changes.

evidence.quote: The detail that matters is that what if changes nothing at all.
What if is a feature that arm technically has, but bicep makes it much more accessible?
For bicep, that means a what if deployment
You get a what-if operation that shows you what would change
And always run the preview command before deploying. In bicep that is what if.
When you deploy bicep, you can run what if mode first. This shows you exactly what will change
